gmoney.title: Reconcile travel and everyday spending in one home currency
gmoney.buyer_job: You have expenses in several currencies and want to understand the total without connecting a bank account.
gmoney.result: A spending summary grouped by category or trip, expressed in your home currency so you can check where the money went.
gmoney.included: G+Money is a paid download. Currency conversion, expense categories, trip or event grouping, summaries, and text or CSV export are included; there is no later in-app unlock.
steps: Choose your home currency and check the rate you intend to use. A saved or manually entered rate can be used offline; fetching a new live rate needs a connection.
Enter the original amount and currency, then assign a category. Add a trip or event tag when that context matters; leave ordinary daily spending unassigned.
Review the category or trip subtotal against your receipts before exporting. Keep the original-currency amount and exchange-rate assumptions in mind when comparing totals.
gmoney.proof_caption: The published summary screen shows category totals and trip filters. It demonstrates the reporting interface, not a verified CSV export or bank reconciliation.
limits: This is manual expense tracking and currency conversion, not bank synchronization, tax preparation, or a financial recommendation.
Converted totals depend on the rate you select. They may differ from the final amount charged by your bank or card provider.
gmoney.alternative: A spreadsheet may be enough if you only need a short expense list and are comfortable maintaining currencies and categories yourself.

faq.q: Can I keep recording expenses without mobile data?
faq.a: Yes. Recording and using saved or manual exchange rates work offline. Do not confuse that with receiving fresh market rates while disconnected.
No. This guide links to the original paid G+Money, not the separate Lite app. The paid-download model on this page applies only to this App Store ID.

hourstag.title: See a possible purchase in work hours before deciding
hourstag.buyer_job: You know an item's price but want a more personal way to judge the trade-off before you spend.
hourstag.result: A price converted into work hours, with Need, Want, or Impulse tags and a history you can revisit.
hourstag.included: HoursTag is a paid download. Price-to-work-time calculations, spending tags, goals, history, and backup are included without an in-app upgrade.
steps: Set your hourly or monthly income in HoursTag. Check that the income assumptions reflect the comparison you want to make.
Enter the proposed price and read the work-time equivalent. Treat it as one perspective on the decision, not an instruction to buy or avoid something.
Label the item Need, Want, or Impulse and review the history later. A goal or wishlist can help you compare several purchases in the same unit.
hourstag.proof_caption: The published calculator screen displays a price as work hours. The numbers belong to the App Store example, not to a user's income or measured savings.
limits: HoursTag does not measure actual hours worked or replace payroll, a timesheet, or tax calculations.
The result depends on your income inputs and cannot decide whether an expense is necessary for you.
hourstag.alternative: A basic calculator can divide a price by an hourly amount. HoursTag is relevant when you also want tags, history, and goals around that comparison.

faq.q: Does it automatically discover my income?
faq.a: No. You provide the income assumptions. That makes the result a personal comparison rather than a statement about your real payroll.

faq.q: Does this link open HoursTag Lite?
faq.a: No. It opens the original HoursTag: Hours to Buy. This guide does not describe the separate Lite app's free allowance or workflow.

lumimath.title: Choose the next visual math practice instead of adding more worksheets
lumimath.buyer_job: You want a short, parent-supported practice session and a useful way to decide what your child should revisit.
lumimath.result: Visual math questions and a progress view that help you choose another practice topic, without treating an app score as a school assessment.
lumimath.free_core: The first planets and daily challenge are free to start.
lumimath.unlock: An optional one-time unlock opens the full galaxy of content; it is not a subscription.
steps: Begin with an available visual question together. Ask the child to explain the picture or pattern rather than rushing to tap an answer.
Use practice at the child's pace when a timed activity is not a good fit. Stop or change topic if the session becomes frustrating.
Review the progress view with the child and pick a topic to revisit. Look for a conversation about the mistake, not a target score to promise.
lumimath.proof_caption: The published progress screen shows skill categories and practice history. These are in-app records, not evidence of measured learning gains.
limits: Practice results do not diagnose learning needs, establish school readiness, or guarantee competition performance.
Contest-style questions are practice material, not official or endorsed competition questions.
lumimath.alternative: Counters, a number line, or a short paper exercise may be the better choice when you want a completely screen-free session.

faq.q: Do I need to buy before trying the learning loop?
faq.a: No. Start with the free first planets and daily challenge, then decide whether you need the larger one-time-unlock content set.

faq.q: Is this the paid Lumi Math Pro app?
faq.a: No. This page links to Lumi Math Planet: Explorer, the free-download app with an optional unlock. Lumi Math Pro is a separate paid download.

lumibopomofopro.title: Practice Zhuyin at home: listen, follow the strokes, then trace
lumibopomofopro.buyer_job: Your family wants Bopomofo sound and writing practice for a child learning Traditional Chinese phonics.
lumibopomofopro.result: A guided sound-and-tracing activity for a chosen Zhuyin symbol, followed by practice games rather than an unsupported reading-level promise.
lumibopomofopro.included: Lumi Bopomofo Pro is a paid download. All 37 symbols, tracing, blending, tone practice, and the included games are available after purchase; there is no in-app unlock.
steps: An adult chooses one familiar symbol and listens with the child. Connect the sound to a word the family actually uses.
Open the tracing activity, watch the stroke guidance, and let the child repeat it without rushing.
Revisit the sound in a matching or blending activity. Use the parent area to review practice, and return to paper when that suits the child better.
lumibopomofopro.proof_caption: The published Magic Tracing screen shows Zhuyin stroke guidance. It demonstrates the activity, not a child's completed assessment.
limits: Zhuyin/Bopomofo is not Latin-letter Hanyu Pinyin. This is not a complete Chinese-character reading curriculum.
The app supports practice; it cannot guarantee first-grade readiness, pronunciation mastery, or a particular pace of learning.
lumibopomofopro.alternative: A school-provided Zhuyin sheet and an adult reading aloud may be enough if you only need a few symbols or prefer handwriting entirely on paper.

faq.q: Will buying this add more purchase prompts during practice?
faq.a: This is the complete paid-download Pro app, with no in-app purchases. An adult should still make the purchase decision.

faq.q: Can a heritage-language family use it outside Taiwan?
faq.a: It can support Bopomofo practice wherever the family studies that phonetic system. Check device and storefront availability on the linked App Store listing.

lumimissionpro.title: Keep a visible record of small family routines
lumimissionpro.buyer_job: You want a shared way to acknowledge brushing teeth, tidying up, or getting ready without building a complicated household system.
lumimissionpro.result: A mission completion card and a parent-viewable record of the actions the family marked complete.
lumimissionpro.included: Lumi Mission Planet Pro is a paid download. The included routines, custom missions, buddies, rewards, parent dashboard, and backup are available without an in-app purchase.
steps: Choose one routine together and make the task concrete. A short, understandable action is easier to review than a vague goal such as being good.
Use the app together and record the small win after the activity. Keep the real routine more important than the screen.
Look at the completion card or parent log later. Adjust the routine to your family's needs instead of interpreting a missed day as failure.
lumimissionpro.proof_caption: The published Mission Complete card is an example of the in-app result. It is not evidence that the app changes a child's behavior.
limits: The history records taps and family input; it does not independently verify that a routine happened.
This is not a behavioral treatment, medical tool, or guarantee of fewer conflicts.
lumimissionpro.alternative: A paper sticker chart may be enough for one visible household routine, especially if everyone prefers a shared physical board.

faq.q: Is a subscription needed for custom missions?
faq.a: No. This guide concerns the complete paid Pro download. The included custom-mission workflow is not a recurring subscription.

faq.q: Should the child use the purchase button?
faq.a: No. This guide and its buying decision are for adults. Use the routine activities together with the child.

tripplanet.title: Give airport waiting one small family mission
tripplanet.buyer_job: You want a bounded activity during a family trip, not an endless stream of videos or another adult packing checklist.
tripplanet.result: A trip mission map that gives a child a small real-world task and a visible place to record progress.
tripplanet.free_core: Start free with one trip and its starter mission experience.
tripplanet.unlock: The optional one-time Plus unlock expands trips, missions, companions, and premium content; it is not a subscription.
steps: Create a trip with the child and choose one safe, concrete task, such as helping check the family bag or saying thank you.
Keep the activity within adult supervision and the immediate travel setting. The app is not a reason to wander away from the gate or approach strangers.
Mark progress on the mission map together, then put the device away. Use another short mission only when it fits the family's day.
tripplanet.proof_caption: The published trip map shows the mission-path interface. Its sample family and trip are illustrative, not a record from a reader.
limits: Trip Planet is a family mission game, not airline tracking, navigation, a safety system, or a promise to prevent travel stress.
Optional family iCloud sharing needs the appropriate Apple services and connection; do not assume every sharing action works offline.
tripplanet.alternative: A parent-made paper scavenger list works well for a single outing. Choose the app when the recurring mission map and collected trip progress are useful.

faq.q: Must I buy Plus before creating the first trip?
faq.a: No. The first trip and starter mission experience form the free core. Plus is an optional one-time expansion, not a paid download requirement.
A simple travel task can be an action, such as helping pack or noticing a color. There is no need to make a child photograph strangers or share personal details.

photocream.title: Preview a consistent photo color style before paying for export extras
photocream.buyer_job: You want several travel or café photos to feel coherent, with control over the look before you commit to an upgrade.
photocream.result: An edited photo preview with visible color controls, so you can decide whether the result and export boundary suit your needs.
photocream.free_core: Download free to use the editing and look-preview workflow. Do not assume every premium pack or watermark-free export is included.
photocream.unlock: A single optional one-time unlock removes the watermark and opens the premium packs.
steps: Choose a photo you own or have permission to edit. Start with a restrained look and check that the important details still look natural to you.
Adjust light and color deliberately rather than assuming one preset fits every photo. Compare the preview before changing more controls.
Check the export options and watermark requirement before sharing. Upgrade only if you need the one-time-unlock features.
photocream.proof_caption: The published color-editing screen shows a café photo and HSL controls. It is an interface example, not an independently measured before-and-after test.
limits: A look or reference style does not guarantee an exact color match across different lighting, cameras, or displays.
Editing cannot establish that an altered image accurately represents a person's appearance or an event.
photocream.alternative: Apple Photos may be enough for a crop and basic light adjustment. PhotoCream is relevant when its look-preview and more detailed color controls fit your workflow.

faq.q: Is trying a look itself the paid feature?
faq.a: No. The free editing and preview workflow is distinct from the one-time unlock for watermark removal and premium packs.

faq.q: Are my photos uploaded for the editing workflow?
faq.a: The published app description states that photo processing runs on the device. Purchases still use Apple's store services.

maskmyfile.title: A black rectangle is not a redaction workflow: verify the exported file
maskmyfile.buyer_job: You need to send a client PDF or image while removing only the private details the recipient does not need.
maskmyfile.result: A new redacted copy, reopened for checking, rather than an editable shape that merely sits over the original information.
maskmyfile.free_core: Import, detect, mark, and preview files free. The first real cleaned-file export is free.
maskmyfile.unlock: An optional one-time unlock enables subsequent verified outputs and the unlocked batch workflow.
steps: Decide which fields the recipient actually needs. Review detected findings and add missed regions or exact-text matches yourself; OCR is a helper, not the final decision.
For an image or PDF, use permanent solid redaction or removal rather than blur or an overlay that leaves the content recoverable. Text and structured-file formats have different masking options.
Create the new copy, reopen it, and inspect the actual output before sending. Check every relevant page and try searching or copying the removed text where the format allows it.
Confirm the destination and share the cleaned copy, not the original. Keep a separate original only when you still need it and are permitted to retain it.
maskmyfile.proof_caption: The published Private Ready screen shows a cleaned example with solid redactions after the app's verification step. The label is not a legal or independent security certification.
limits: Automatic detection can miss sensitive information. A Private Ready label does not replace your review or establish regulatory compliance.
Metadata removal depends on the format. This app does not clean information from copies already sent, remote backups, a VPN, or network traffic.
maskmyfile.alternative: If a desktop PDF editor already offers permanent redaction and output verification, that may be the simplest tool. Do not substitute drawing a shape for a real redaction feature.

faq.q: Can I inspect the file before deciding to buy?
faq.a: Yes. Import, detection, manual selections, and preview are free; one real cleaned-file export is also free. Later exports require the one-time unlock.

faq.q: Does the screenshot prove every private field was found?
faq.a: No. It shows the published output interface for an example file. You still decide what must be removed and verify your own exported copy.

caldaily.title: Remember what a bill-split result means a week later
caldaily.buyer_job: You can calculate the number, but later you cannot remember which dinner, discount, or comparison it belonged to.
caldaily.result: A saved result with a name and type, making the calculation easier to find instead of reconstructing it from an unexplained number.
caldaily.free_core: Basic calculations, history, the interactive calculator widget, and the default theme are free. Each advanced tool has three successful free uses.
caldaily.unlock: An optional one-time Premium purchase unlocks the other themes and unlimited advanced-tool use.
steps: Use the calculator or an appropriate tool and check the inputs. For a split bill, confirm the total and number of people before accepting the result.
Give the result a meaningful name and type while the context is still fresh.
Find it again in history by name, day, or tool. Treat the saved calculation as a record of your inputs, not as a receipt or payment confirmation.
caldaily.proof_caption: The published result screen shows a saved dinner calculation with a name and type. It demonstrates a record, not a bank transaction or proof of payment.
limits: A saved result is only as accurate as the formula and inputs. Loan, date, tax, and other practical calculations are not professional advice.
This evidence concerns the in-app saved-result workflow, not a measured widget-response-time test.
caldaily.alternative: A basic calculator and a note may be enough for an occasional split. CalDaily is relevant when searchable calculation history is part of your everyday routine.

faq.q: Does every calculation consume a free use?
faq.a: No. Basic calculations and history do not consume the advanced-tool allowance. Each advanced tool has three successful free results before its one-time-unlock boundary.

faq.q: Does saving a result charge or pay anyone?
faq.a: No. A result records a calculation. It does not initiate a bank transfer, settle a bill, or certify a payment.
